description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain franchise located in the Lake Hill neighbourhood near McKenzie Avenue and Borden Street, serving the broader Saanich area. They emphasize quality ingredients including antibiotic-free chicken and pork, 100% organic tomato sauce, and dough made fresh daily. In addition to pizzas, the menu includes wings, salads, sides, and desserts, with delivery available across a wide swath of Saanich.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is open and operating at 1110A McKenzie Avenue, Victoria, BC V8P 5P5, matching the OSM address and unit. The website explicitly states Panago offers 'vegan, vegetarian and gluten-smart options,' confirming dietary accommodations.
